title: ChargePoint Public Session Failure Rate
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chargepoint:session
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as sessions, count(eval(status!="completed")) as failed_sessions by site_name _time
| eval failed_pct=round(100*failed_sessions/sessions,1)
| where sessions>=3 AND failed_pct>20
| sort - failed_pct
description: Uses ChargePoint session exports telemetry to monitor monthly completion reliability by public charging site in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for favorite chargers that keep failing in practice, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest ChargePoint session exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly site table of completed versus failed sessions.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights monthly completion reliability by public charging site so you can spot favorite chargers that keep failing in practice before it becomes annoying.
